title: MAGIC ENGLISH BEGINNER — WORLD 4: REAL LIFE ENGLISH QUEST
description: A dense A1 world built around everyday communication, longer listening, practical reading, guided writing, role-play, problem solving and independent speaking.

missions.title: My Morning Mission
speaking: Say what you do before school.
grammar: I brush my teeth before breakfast.
After breakfast, I go to school.

missions.title: My School Subjects
speaking: Say which subject is easy or hard for you.

missions.title: Family Conversations
speaking: Describe who lives in your home.
Ask a family member five simple questions.
listening: Listen for who does what at home.

missions.title: The House Tour
speaking: Give a simple tour of your home.
grammar: There is a sofa in the living room.
The mirror is above the table.
The shoes are next to the door.

missions.title: Food and Healthy Choices
speaking: Talk about foods you like and dislike.
Ask what someone wants to eat.

missions.title: Shopping Mission
speaking: Ask for an item and price.
grammar: Can I have a blue one, please?

missions.title: The Café Conversation
grammar: I would like a sandwich, please.
I would like the bill, please.

missions.title: Bus and Train English
speaking: Ask where the bus or train goes.
grammar: My seat is next to the window.

missions.title: World 4 Conversation Hub
speaking: Hold a guided conversation about your day.
Ask and answer questions about family, school and food.
listening: Identify people, places, times, needs and preferences.
reading: Read a 150-word practical dialogue and answer questions.
writing: Write 10 sentences about a normal school day.
missions.challenge: Complete three English-only role-plays: school, café and transport.

missions.title: Jobs Around Us
speaking: Say what job you would like to try.
grammar: A teacher works at a school.

missions.title: My Neighborhood Map
speaking: Give directions from school to a park.
grammar: The library is between the school and the shop.
The park is opposite the hospital.

missions.title: Birthday Party Planner
speaking: Say what you need for the party.
listening: Identify party date, place and activities.
grammar: I am going to have a party.

missions.title: My Free Time
speaking: Say how often you do three activities.
listening: Understand a short interview about hobbies.

missions.title: My First Mini Presentation
speaking: Give a 60–90 second presentation about yourself.
Use first, next, also and finally.
listening: Identify the main points and details.
reading: Read a model presentation and identify its structure.

missions.title: Story Quest: A Day in the City
speaking: Retell the story in your own words.
listening: Identify main idea and five details.
reading: Answer who, what, where, when and why questions.

missions.title: Problem-Solving English
speaking: Explain a simple problem in three sentences.
listening: Identify problem, important detail and solution.
grammar: I need help because I am lost.
Can you show me the way?

missions.title: Listening Lab — Natural A1
speaking: Answer listening questions in complete sentences.
listening: Understand clear natural A1 speech at normal speed.
Identify gist, key details and speaker intention.
Distinguish familiar words inside connected sentences.
missions.challenge: Complete three listening rounds: gist → details → spoken response.

missions.title: English Without Translation
speaking: Describe an object for a partner to guess.
Explain a simple choice using because.
listening: Understand short instructions and follow-up questions.
reading: Read connected A1 paragraphs and infer simple meaning from context.
missions.challenge: Complete a timed English-only response round with no translation prompts.

missions.title: WORLD 4 FINAL MASTER QUEST — REAL LIFE ENGLISH
speaking: Role-play a shop or café interaction.
listening: Understand a 2-minute clear natural A1 dialogue/story.
Identify gist, key details, sequence and simple intention.
reading: Read a 220–260 word A1 practical story or dialogue and answer comprehension questions.
writing: Write 12–15 connected sentences about your everyday life.
missions.challenge: Complete an English-only real-life quest combining listening, speaking, reading, writing and role-play.
missions.mastery_target: Learner can manage familiar everyday exchanges, understand clear connected A1 speech, read short practical texts, tell simple stories and produce connected personal writing.

world_review.mastery: Learner demonstrates a strong A1 foundation with connected everyday communication, practical role-play, short presentations, story retelling and increasingly natural listening.
